name: Warp object
description: An animated wave distortion for objects.

parameters.name: X frequency
parameters.desc: Number of waves on the X axis.

parameters.name: Y frequency
parameters.desc: Number of waves on the Y axis.

parameters.name: X amplitude
parameters.desc: Amplitude of waves on the X axis, in pixels.

parameters.name: Y amplitude
parameters.desc: Amplitude of waves on the Y axis, in pixels.

parameters.name: X speed
parameters.desc: Speed of the wave animation on the X axis, in cycles per second.

parameters.name: Y speed
parameters.desc: Speed of the wave animation on the Y axis, in cycles per second.
